claim: In the generalized entangled coherent-state multiphase protocol of Liu, Lu, Sun, and Wang, let \(x=|\alpha|^2\ge1\), \(t=e^{-x}\), and let \(d\ge2\) be the integer number of unknown phases. The source's normalization ellipse gives \(\Gamma^{-2}=d(1-t)(1+dt)\), while its unconstrained optimal coefficients are \[b_L^2=\frac{1+x^{-1}}{d+\sqrt d}\]for linear phase generators and \[b_N^2=\frac{f(x)}{g(x)(d+\sqrt d)},\qquad f(x)=x^3+6x^2+7x+1,\quad g(x)=x(x+1)^2,\]for quadratic generators. Define \(\mathcal R(A,B,C)\) as the unique positive root of \(As^3+Bs-C=0\). Then the formal linear optimum is physically normalizable exactly when \[d\le R_L(x)^2,\qquad R_L(x)=\mathcal R((x+1)t(1-t),\,1-(x+1)t,\,x),\]and the nonlinear optimum is physically normalizable exactly when \[d\le R_N(x)^2,\qquad R_N(x)=\mathcal R(f(x)t(1-t),\,f(x)(1-t)-g(x),\,g(x)).\]All cubic coefficients multiplying \(s\) are positive for \(x\ge1\), so each boundary is unique. As \(x\to\infty\), \[R_L(x)^2\sim x^2,\qquad R_N(x)^2\sim \frac{x^2}{16},\]so at fixed coherent amplitude the maximum phase count for which the source's unconstrained optimum is realizable is asymptotically sixteen times larger in the linear protocol than in the nonlinear protocol. For the source's illustrative scale \(|\alpha|=4\), the exact integer capacities are \(d\le255\) for the linear optimum and \(d\le17\) for the nonlinear optimum.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic finite replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact analytic feasibility boundaries for the source's linear and nonlinear formal optima, including the asymptotic factor-16 difference in phase-count capacity.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The generalized ECS ansatz, normalization ellipse, QFIMs, formal optimal coefficients, and graphical achievability regions are credited to Liu--Lu--Sun--Wang; the generalized NOON multiphase benchmark is credited to Humphreys--Barbieri--Datta--Walmsley.

scientific_limitations: The result classifies normalization feasibility of the source's unconstrained inverse-QFIM minimizers, not detector-level saturation of the quantum Cramer-Rao bound.
It assumes the source's real-coefficient generalized entangled coherent-state family, x=|alpha|^2>=1, and integer d>=2.
The factor 16 is an asymptotic phase-count capacity ratio at fixed coherent amplitude, not an estimation-variance ratio.
An equivalent elimination of the normalization ellipse may exist in unindexed or differently parameterized literature.
title: Exact mode-capacity boundaries for generalized entangled coherent-state metrology
